args.title: Remember last used export format in browser storage
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Remember the user's last selected export format in localStorage so that opening a report defaults to the previously chosen format instead of always reverting to CSV.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Remember the last selected export format in browser storage (localStorage) so users don't have to re-select their preferred format every time.
